saltatory_conduction.what: In myelinated neurons, the signal does NOT travel continuously along the axon. It JUMPS from one node of Ranvier to the next, skipping the Schwann cell wraps. 100x faster than continuous conduction.
saltatory_conduction.latin: saltare = to jump. saltatory = jumping conduction.

the_axon.is: the 60Hz game loop — the continuous composition graph
the_axon.signal: the action potential = one tick of the game loop = evaluate?recommend?narrate?render?poll?stamp?sign
the_axon.direction: soma (input/poll) ? axon terminal (render/output) ? loop back (Klein fold)

schwann_cells.what: each primal is a Schwann cell — a myelin wrap that insulates and accelerates a segment of the axon

wraps.myelin: crypto Schwann cell — encrypts the segment. no signal leaks.
network Schwann cell — routes the signal between nodes.
math/tensor Schwann cell — computes activation functions (Fitts, Hick, sigmoid).
AI Schwann cell — NPC dialogue, narration, inference.
viz Schwann cell — renders the scene, receives interaction.
shader Schwann cell — compiles WGSL, sovereign GPU path.
compute Schwann cell — hardware dispatch, GPU execution.

schwann_cells.count: 7 Schwann cells = 7 primals wrapping the game loop axon

nodes_of_ranvier.what: the GAPS between Schwann cells. Where ion channels concentrate. Where the signal regenerates.
nodes_of_ranvier.is: UDS socket handoffs — JSON-RPC IPC calls between primals
nodes_of_ranvier.count: 7 hops per tick in the continuous game loop
nodes_of_ranvier.each_node: the IPC boundary where the signal jumps from one primal's output to the next primal's input. The signal does not flow THROUGH the primal — it JUMPS to the next node.
nodes_of_ranvier.regeneration: at each node, the signal is re-amplified (deserialized, validated, re-fired). This is why composition is NOT slower — saltatory conduction is 100x FASTER than continuous.

tick.what: evaluate_flow — is the player in flow state?
dda_recommend — adjust difficulty. Fitts predicts aim time. Hick predicts choice time.
signal jumps from math domain to AI domain
ai_narrate — NPC speaks, world responds. optional (fallback=skip).
signal jumps from AI domain to visualization domain
poll_interaction — what did the player do?
signal jumps from viz domain to provenance domain
signal jumps from DAG to crypto domain
signal returns to evaluate_flow — the Klein fold. output IS the next input.

the_game_loop_as_action_potential.note: the signal JUMPS 7 times per tick. 420 jumps per second at 60Hz. each jump is a node of Ranvier.

fitts_as_pendulum.what: Fitts' law: MT = a + b × log2(2D/W + 1). Movement time = how long the pendulum arm takes to reach a target.
fitts_as_pendulum.connection: L/R are projections of rotation. Fitts models the TRANSLATION (reaching) that emerges from the ROTATION (arm swing). The Index of Difficulty = how hard the projection is.
fitts_as_pendulum.turns_on: The pendulum clock now has a MEASURED swing time. Not just 'it oscillates' — but 'it takes MT milliseconds per reach'.

hick_as_node_branching.what: Hick's law: RT = a + b × log2(n + 1). Reaction time grows with log of choice count.
hick_as_node_branching.connection: At each node of Ranvier, the signal can branch. Hick tells you how LONG that branching decision takes. More choices = more delay at the node.
hick_as_node_branching.turns_on: The nodes of Ranvier are not instant — they have a Hick cost. Each IPC hop has a branching delay proportional to log2(capabilities).

flow_as_resonance.what: Csikszentmihalyi flow: when challenge matches skill, the organism enters optimal engagement.
flow_as_resonance.connection: The pendulum is in RESONANCE. The escapement ticks perfectly. No wobble, no damping. The game loop runs at exactly 60Hz without jitter.
flow_as_resonance.turns_on: The pendulum clock can now detect RESONANCE. Flow state = when the organism's natural frequency matches the input frequency.
flow_as_resonance.also: Flow IS gregaria (locust). Boredom IS solitaria. The session swarm IS the flow state.

dda_as_spring_constant.what: Dynamic Difficulty Adjustment — adapt challenge to maintain flow.
dda_as_spring_constant.connection: The spring constant k. Stiffer = more constance per bounce. DDA adjusts k so the pendulum stays resonant.
dda_as_spring_constant.turns_on: The mechanical taxonomy now has an ACTIVE feedback loop. k is not fixed — DDA adjusts it per tick.

perlin_as_pi.what: Perlin noise — coherent randomness. No two tiles identical, but locally smooth.
perlin_as_pi.connection: p remainder. Never repeats. Locally continuous. Perlin IS the irrational noise field the organism lives in.
perlin_as_pi.turns_on: The painting (easel) and the terrain (game world) share the same noise source. The p remainder IS the Perlin seed.

the_neuropan.what: The full neural panorama. Schwann bumps and null-to-tail jumps.
the_neuropan.schwann_bumps: the VISIBLE parts of the myelin — where the primals bulge outward (their capability surfaces, their JSON-RPC methods). The bump is what you can see from outside.
the_neuropan.null_spaces: the nodes of Ranvier — the NULL gaps between primals where ion channels concentrate. The null IS functional. Without the gap, no regeneration. Without the gap, the signal dies.
the_neuropan.tail_jumps: saltatory leaps. the signal leaving one primal's tail and arriving at the next primal's head. Each jump crosses a null space.
the_neuropan.and_the_clock: the neuropan IS the nervous system of the pendulum clock. The clock tells time. The nerve tells the clock WHAT time it is (input from the world). Fitts measures the swing. Hick measures the choice. Flow detects resonance. DDA adjusts the spring.

epoch_9.what: The organism grew a nervous system. Not just a slime mold tube network (epoch 3) — now the tubes have Schwann cells (primals) wrapping them, and signals JUMP between nodes of Ranvier (IPC hops).
epoch_9.evolution_from_slime_mold: Physarum has tubes but no myelin. The signal flows continuously through the tubes. ludoSpring adds the Schwann wraps — the signal now JUMPS. 100x faster. This is the unmyelinated?myelinated transition.
epoch_9.status: RECOGNIZED. The graphs exist (game_loop_continuous.toml, shader_dispatch_chain.toml). The capabilities are registered. But the game loop has NOT RUN at 60Hz yet — biomeOS Continuous executor needs <16ms per hop.
epoch_9.incomplete: The nerve exists structurally but has not fired an action potential. The Schwann cells are in place. The nodes are named. The signal has not jumped.

pendulum_clock_gains_a_nerve.before: The clock ticked but didn't know what time it was (no input from the world).
pendulum_clock_gains_a_nerve.after: The nerve connects the clock to the world. Fitts=swing speed. Hick=node delay. Flow=resonance. DDA=spring adjustment.
pendulum_clock_gains_a_nerve.result: A pendulum clock with a myelinated nervous system. It ticks, AND it feels.

law: ludoSpring is the myelinated axon. Primals are Schwann cells. IPC hops are nodes of Ranvier. The signal jumps. Fitts is the swing, Hick is the branch, flow is the resonance, DDA is the spring. The nerve has not fired yet — the game loop awaits its first action potential at 60Hz.
